notes:
Inbound via self-serve signup (product hunt mention). Initial trial activated 2026-03-05. Joined discovery call 2026-03-08 (ff_2026-03-08_6741). Quick summary notes below:
- Company: Sunfold Payments — payments orchestration for SMB merchants, PCI-adjacent but pushing most PII to PSP.
- Team: 18 engineers, 3 infra, 2 security. CTO (R. Halvorsen) technical lead on integrations.
- Use-case stated on signup: customer support chatbot + automated transaction summarization for monthly statements. Also interested in embeddings for internal doc search (SOPs, compliance notes).
- Early security asks: "We need SOC2 in vendor pack" — asked for SOC2 cert + recent pen test summary. SSO/SCIM (SAML) must be available for enterprise tier.
- Deployment posture: starting hosted API (public cloud) for speed; product/ops curious about VPC/private for Q3 if traffic grows. Not urgent but flagged for procurement.
- Latency/throughput: need sub-300ms median for support replies, bursty during 9-11am PST; expect ~200K tokens/month initially, cost sensitive.
- Model preference: prefer smaller open models or Redwood-curated mid-size models to control cost; receptive to quantized variants if quality preserved.
- Routing/fallback: wants policy to route to cheaper model during non-peak, fallback to higher-quality for flagged transactions.
- Quote from CTO: "We need something that just works — low ops burden. SOC2 + easy SSO = must-haves for procurement."
- Actions so far: sent pricing snapshot 2026-03-09, shared hosted quickstart + sample curl 2026-03-10. SE intro 2026-03-11 (Liam).
- POC ask: 2-week sandbox to validate support flows + 10k-message embedding index for docs. Will share prompt set.
- Procurement: procurement lead assigned but requires SOC2 doc before moving to paid trial.
- Notes style: fragments, copied verbatim from call; some repetition expected.
